meta.name: cicd-automation
meta.description: Use for CI/CD, pipeline automation, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Argo, Azure DevOps, build-test-scan-package-deploy flows, release orchestration, protected environments, approvals, and rollback.

copy.tagline: 自动执行构建、测试、扫码、打包与发布流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在负责项目的构建、测试与发版流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate your build, test, and release pipelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain or trigger build and deploy pipelines

howto.what: 装了这个技能后,Claude 会帮你设计 CI/CD 交付流水线,让它可预测、可观察、安全且能回滚。它会先阅读参考文档,再根据你的平台和部署需求,生成流水线配置(YAML/脚本),并给出验证步骤、回滚方案和假设说明。
howto.when: 当你提到 CI/CD、流水线自动化,或涉及 GitHub Actions、GitLab CI、Jenkins 等平台,以及构建-测试-扫描-打包-部署、发布编排、环境审批等环节,或要求回滚时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 GitHub Actions 流水线,从构建到部署。
say.note: Claude 会阅读流程文档并生成流水线配置。

say.text: 为我的发布流程选择蓝绿发布模式,并写出验证和回滚步骤。
say.note: 它会给出发布方案和回滚路径。

say.text: 在流水线中加入质量门禁和手动审批,并给出 YAML 示例。
say.note: Claude 会产出带门禁的流水线文件。

howto.what_en: Claude designs deterministic, observable, secure, reversible CI/CD pipelines. It reads the workflow reference, maps the flow, picks release patterns, writes pipeline YAML/scripts, and lists validation, rollback, assumptions.
howto.when_en: Trigger when the user mentions CI/CD, pipeline automation, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc., or build-test-scan-package-deploy, release orchestration, approvals, rollback.

say_en.text: Design a GitHub Actions pipeline from build to deploy.
say_en.note: Claude reads the workflow doc and generates config.

say_en.text: Pick blue/green release for my flow and list validation and rollback steps.
say_en.note: It provides the release strategy and rollback path.

say_en.text: Add quality gates and manual approval to the pipeline, with YAML example.
say_en.note: Claude returns a pipeline file with gates.
